_README: Online profile: a desktop or laptop computer with a mouse (fine pointer and hover), Chrome, Edge or Firefox (device.browser_engines, author 2026-10-15), full screen, a 60 Hz display, and at least 1920 x 1080 physical (backing-store) pixels, on the screen before consent and in the full-screen window at the start (within 2 px of rounding). Native panel resolution cannot be verified by browser APIs. Author, 2026-10-14: no viewing distance, no visual angle, no card, no physical-diagonal check: the geometry of every run is the experiment file's reference layout (display.sizing) scaled to the full-screen window, which fits every window of at least the minimums by construction. Author, 2026-10-12, retry first, refuse last: a screen too small for its size alone gets the zoom screen and device.zoom_retries new checks. Existing runs use their saved profile and configuration snapshots.

study_key._pattern_note_2026_10_29: Uncertainty_BSR_v2 (author 2026-10-29: its own Prolific and JATOS studies): the optional _v<n> tag of a later pilot (pilot_bsr_v2_s1) is not part of the experiment name, so the key still names config/experiments/pilot_bsr.json, session 1, while its codes slot (pilot_bsr_v2_s1_w1) stays apart from v1's; no context is read from it (the server alternation assigns S or L, as in v1).
study_key._pattern_note_2026_10_28: Uncertainty_BSR_v1 (2026-10-28): one Prolific study per context, so S and L need their own study keys and code slots: pilot_bsr_S_s1 and pilot_bsr_L_s1 name config/experiments/pilot_bsr.json, session 1, and the page reads the context from the key (contextFromAddress, src/online/index.ts) when the address has no context parameter. pilot_bsr_s1 (with ?context=) still works for the demo.
study_key._pattern_note: 2026-10-27 (nb/pilot-bsr-demo): pilot_bsr_s1 names config/experiments/pilot_bsr.json, session 1 (its context comes from the address parameter context, session.context_parameter of that file); exp0 and exp1 keys unchanged.

counterbalance._rule_note: Author, 2026-10-14: exact balance of the session order in one Prolific study per session. Session 1 takes the context with fewer assignments so far in the JATOS batch session (store context_order_<experiment>; ties: S) and stores it for the participant; Session 2 reads it back. One JATOS study, one batch and one link serve both sessions (ops/jatos/study.json), so they share the store. Without the batch session the hash of the participant identifier decides (the old rule, participant_hash) and the session file says so (online.counterbalance.used, .server.outcome). Set rule to participant_hash to go back to the hash alone.

device._browser_engines_note: Author, 2026-10-15: Chrome, Edge and Firefox only. The pixel sizing reads the browser zoom from devicePixelRatio, which Safari does not change under zoom. chromium = Chrome and Edge, gecko = Firefox; every other Chromium browser (Opera, Brave, Vivaldi, Chromium itself) reports the same engine and passes too, as does a Gecko browser that names itself Firefox. Detected from navigator.userAgentData.brands when present (Chromium browsers), else from the user-agent string (Safari has Safari/ and Version/ without Chrome/, Chromium/, CriOS, Edg/, Firefox/ or FxiOS). Safari, every WebKit-only browser and any engine not recognised are refused before consent as browser (device_refused:browser; the device-refused screen, unpaid like the other device refusals); the browser detected, its version and the brands read are in the device record (device.browser). Remove the key to let any browser in.
device._minimums_note_2026_10_14: Author, 2026-10-14: participation needs at least min_physical_width_px x min_physical_height_px physical pixels in the full-screen window too (start_check.window_size; refused as window_size). The 15.6-inch diagonal check (min_diagonal_inches) and the card are removed.
device._zoom_retries_note: Author, 2026-10-12: a device refused for the screen size alone (screen_width, screen_height) sees text.online.zoom_check (browser zoom at 100 %, Ctrl+0 or Cmd+0; the window on the main high-resolution screen) and is checked again after its button, at most this many times; refused only when the last check still fails. Chrome's devicePixelRatio includes the browser zoom, so 67 % and 90 % zoom refused real 1920 x 1080 screens in wave 9. Every check is in device.attempts. 0 = refused at once.

saving._notes: 2026-10-12: every JATOS call may take call_floor_ms plus its bytes at call_bytes_per_s (a block line of about 1 MB: 8 s + 33 s) instead of the fixed end_wait_ms of earlier builds. A call past its deadline holds back the next call of its kind until jatos.js answers it (jatos.js retries each request itself, for up to about three minutes); the channel then takes calls again, so Retry saving can still succeed. final_wait_ms is the shortest final saving attempt and the longest wait for the last block sends; the attempt is extended while the final upload or its line is within its deadline (a run of 2026-10-05 reported a failure after 12 s although its file arrived). end_wait_ms bounds the wait for the end of the study before the redirect and every call of the refusal screens.

resume._max_resumes_note: Author, 2026-10-14: one restart. An interruption is leaving full screen, switching to another tab, window or program (the page hidden or the focus lost), losing the pointer lock, a reload, or closing and reopening the study link; one departure counts once; reloads, reopenings and pauses inside a block count together over the whole run, practice and main blocks. The first restarts the interrupted block from its first trial, with the warning on the pause or welcome-back screen; the second ends the run at once with stopped.reason interruption_limit: no end survey, no completion code, no payment (text.stop.interruption_lines, the participant returns the submission). The participant texts (text.online.leave_warning, resume, pause, fullscreen) state this rule; change them with this number. Was 3 (2026-10-06).
resume._brief_loss_ms_note: Author 2026-10-19: a lost focus or hidden page during the cloud or the mask that is back within 1 s aborts that trial only (no points, no deduction, recorded) and is not a departure; 1 s or longer stays a departure. A resize, a change of the device pixel ratio, a lost full screen or a lost pointer lock keep their handling.
